import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dP_dt
def fit(fn,p0,n=12):
    best=None
    for s in range(n):
        p=np.random.RandomState(s).randn(len(p0))*0.7+np.array(p0)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda q: fn(q)-y,p,max_nfev=4000)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception: pass
    return round(float(np.mean((y-fn(best.x))**2)/np.var(y)),6), np.round(best.x,3)
print('F1',fit(lambda q: q[0]*t**q[1]+q[2]*P+q[3]*P**2+q[4]*P*t,[1,0.5,1,-0.1,0.1]))
print('F2',fit(lambda q: q[0]*t+q[1]*P*(1-P/q[2])+q[3]*t/P+q[4]*np.log(t),[1,1,6,0.5,1]))
print('F3',fit(lambda q: q[0]*P*np.exp(-q[1]*t)+q[2]*t+q[3]*P**2+q[4],[1,0.2,1,-0.1,1]))
print('F4',fit(lambda q: q[0]*P*(1-P/q[1])*(1+q[2]*t)+q[3]*t**q[4],[1,6,0.1,1,0.5]))
print('F5',fit(lambda q: q[0]*t+q[1]*P*np.log(q[2]/P)+q[3]*np.sin(q[4]*t),[1,1,6,1,0.5]))
